derivation: Each supplied finiteF4*finiteE4 product is exactly BF16 and an integer multiple of2^-10. Sign multiplication preserves this grid and magnitude.
Inductively, at stage s the exact sum/difference magnitude is<=2688*2^s. This bound is representableF32, so nearest-even rounding cannot exceed it.
A F32 rounding of a multiple of2^-10 remains on that grid: when the F32 spacing is finer the input is exactly representable; when it is coarser the rounded result is still a multiple.
After6stages values are zero or magnitude>=2^-10, <=172032. Scalingby1/8 is exactnormal, yielding zero or magnitude>=2^-13 and <=21504.
Final BF16 nearest-even rounding cannot overflow/underflow for this range. This is a range proof for provided-format WEIGHTS, not a proof of exactF32 rotation or of arbitrary activations.
